verdict.stance: Neutral / BBB-/Baa3 Dead Sea Potash & Specialty Chemicals Producer
verdict.summary: ICL Group is a global leader in bromine, potash, and specialty phosphates backed by the low-cost Dead Sea concession ($7.15bn FY25 sales, $1.49bn Adj EBITDA; FY26 guidance $1.4bn-$1.6bn). Leverage remains manageable (~2.0x gross), though Dead Sea concession renewal terms ahead of 2030 remain a key medium-term credit overhang.

positives: First-quartile global cost position in Dead Sea potash and bromine with ~21% EBITDA margin.
Consistent $1.4bn-$1.6bn annual EBITDA scale with diversified specialty solutions segment.
Investment-grade BBB-/Baa3 ratings with long-dated 2036/2038 bond curve and 2030 RCF liquidity.
negatives: Dead Sea concession expires in 2030; Israeli government tender/renewal royalty terms create medium-term uncertainty.
Regional logistics/security disruptions in Southern Israel and Red Sea shipping routes.
Cyclical potash and phosphate fertilizer price sensitivity.
